name: Eco-Shield
author: Ssebuwufu Moses

sections.description:
Eco-Shield is the lightweight, “set-it-and-forget-it” solution for faster, greener WordPress sites.

Standard YouTube and Vimeo embeds can significantly slow down websites and lower PageSpeed scores. A single video embed often loads over 1.7MB of JavaScript and tracks your users before they even click play.

Eco-Shield fixes this automatically.

It replaces YouTube and Vimeo embeds with a lightweight “Smart Facade”—a static image that looks exactly like the real player. The heavy video scripts are only loaded when your visitor actually clicks “Play.”

Comprehensive Protection:
Eco-Shield automatically detects and optimizes:
* Gutenberg Blocks: Core YouTube and Vimeo blocks.
* Auto-Embeds (oEmbed): Plain YouTube/Vimeo URLs pasted into the editor.
* Legacy Iframes: Hard-coded iframes from YouTube and Vimeo.

Why use Eco-Shield?

  • 🚀 Instant Speed Boost: Drastically reduces initial page size (often by 1MB+ per video).
  • 🌱 Eco-Friendly: Reduces data transfer and server energy usage, lowering your site’s carbon footprint.
  • 🔒 Privacy First (GDPR/DSGVO): Blocks third-party tracking cookies and scripts until the user explicitly interacts with the content.
  • ⚡ Zero Configuration: No confusing settings. No bloat. Just activate it, and your site is instantly faster.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the eco-shield.zip file to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. That’s it! There are no settings to configure. Your videos are automatically protected.
sections.faq:
Where is the settings page?

There isn’t one! Eco-Shield is designed to be “Zero Config.” We believe performance shouldn’t require a manual. Once activated, it automatically protects all YouTube and Vimeo embeds in your posts and pages.

Does this work with block themes (Full Site Editing)?

Yes. We hook into render_block to ensure compatibility with modern block themes as well as classic the_content filters.

Does this support Vimeo?

Yes. It supports both YouTube and Vimeo standard URLs and embeds.

Is it compatible with caching plugins?

Yes. Because our replacement happens on the server side (PHP) before the page is cached, it is fully compatible with WP Rocket, LiteSpeed, W3 Total Cache, and others.
